zh.input.afterScript: 剧本已生成但还没确认：改完上面的内容点「重新生成」会整条重写；只想换风格或角色名，去「剧本生成」。
zh.input.hint: 输入网页链接或正文；下一步再定脚本风格与角色名，然后手动开始生成。

zh.input.placeholder: 例如：https://36kr.com/p/xxxxx　或直接粘贴文章正文

zh.input.subHint: 支持文章链接（自动抓正文）或直接粘贴文字；内容越具体，剧本越贴题。
zh.material.cardApplied: 第 {n} 段已改用信息卡，确认后进入合成
zh.material.cardAutoHint: 逐段判断哪几段适合做成人物 / 对比 / 时间线 / 数据卡，适合的自动生成并叠在素材上
zh.material.cardCleared: 第 {n} 段已恢复实拍素材
zh.material.cardHint: 按这段台词生成人物 / 对比 / 时间线 / 数据卡，叠在这段素材上
zh.material.cardRewritten: 版式卡已换文案，成片会按新卡片重新合成
zh.material.changeCardHint: 让 AI 换个标题重新写这张卡
zh.material.changeClipTitle: 换掉底下这段实拍素材，信息卡保留
zh.material.chapterHint: 章节卡时长，0 = 不出章节卡
zh.material.durations: 片头 / 章节 / 片尾（秒）
zh.material.failed: 素材匹配没成功，可以换个来源重试。
zh.material.failedDetail: 上次匹配没成功。可以换个素材来源或分辨率，再点「用新来源重新匹配」。
zh.material.hintDone: 每段都配好视频了：点开看看，不满意就换一个；确认后去「成片预览」设字幕与 BGM 再生成。
zh.material.introHint: 片头时长，0 = 不出片头
zh.material.needTts: 配音还没完成，素材匹配会在配音结束后开始。
zh.material.newClip: 第 {n} 段已选好新素材，点「下一步：成片预览」后生效。
zh.material.noNewClip: 第 {n} 段没有检索到新的候选素材。
zh.material.orderHint: 依次为片头 / 章节 / 片尾
zh.material.outroDuration: 片尾时长，0 = 不出片尾
zh.material.overlayOnly: 叠加在素材上，不替换画面
zh.material.previewRetry: 预览还没生成好，点这里重试
zh.material.ready: 配音已完成，点「开始匹配素材」，AI 会按每段台词找可用的视频素材。
zh.material.regenerateConfirmBody: 已匹配的素材与已生成的成片都会作废。
zh.material.regenerateHint: 改完上面的设置，点「重新生成」会按新设置重做素材；已匹配的素材与成片会一起作废。
zh.material.rejudgeCard: 重新让 AI 判断这段该用哪种卡
zh.material.runHint: 点「开始匹配素材」后按这个配置一次跑完：片头 → 逐段素材 → 信息卡。
zh.material.searching: 正在按台词检索并下载素材，完成后会在这里逐段列出来。
zh.material.stopped: 已停止，之前匹配出来的素材不完整。点「继续」接着补齐没匹配的段落。
zh.material.title: 素材确认
zh.prompts.title: 提示词
zh.render.bgmPlaceholder: 留空 = 程序合成的默认 BGM；也可填音乐目录里的文件名
zh.render.empty: 成片生成后会出现在这里。
zh.render.hint: 成片已经保存在本地。上面这些参数改完可以重新生成，配音与素材都不用重跑。
zh.render.hintNoTts: 素材已就绪，先设置字幕与背景音乐，再点「生成成片」。
zh.render.noTask: 还没有任务，请先回到第一步生成剧本。
zh.result.bgmToggle: 插入背景音乐（不勾选则只保留配音）
zh.result.fontHint: 字号按画面宽度算好（{n}px，当前 {w}×{h}），可以直接改。改字号会重新渲染分段片段，只改 BGM 则复用片段、仅重跑合并与混音。
zh.result.hint: 成片已生成，每段用的就是下面的素材。想换素材，点上面的「重新生成」按新来源重做。
zh.result.noTask: 还没有任务，请先生成剧本并完成素材确认。
zh.result.title: 成片预览
zh.script.confirmedReadonly: 剧本已确认并用于配音，这里是当时的版本（只读）。
zh.script.done: 正在跑，跑完会自动切到剧本页
zh.script.hint: 设定脚本风格与角色名，点「开始生成」后 AI 会抓取内容写稿，完成停在这里等你确认。
zh.script.hint2: 台词可以直接改，用不上的整条可以删掉；点下一步去选配音，确认后才开始合成。
zh.script.needLine: 剧本至少要留一条台词
zh.script.nextHint: 下一步选脚本风格与角色名，确认后才开始写稿
zh.script.regenerateConfirmBody: 当前剧本（含未保存的修改），以及已生成的配音、素材与成片都会作废。
zh.script.regenerateHint: 丢弃当前剧本（含未保存的修改）以及后续配音、素材与成片，按上面的内容、风格与角色名重写
zh.script.regenerateHint2: 改完上面的风格或角色名，点「重新生成」会按新设置重写整篇；当前剧本与后面的配音、素材、成片都会作废。
zh.script.running: AI 正在抓取内容并写剧本，完成后会自动停在这里等确认。
zh.script.stopped: 已停止。抓取和写稿都是分步落盘的，点「继续」会从断掉的那一步接着跑。

zh.settings.sec.audio.label: 背景音乐

zh.settings.sec.general.desc: 界面相关的偏好，只保存在这台电脑上，不会写进配置文件。

zh.settings.sec.llm.desc: 写稿用的对话模型。填 Key 之后才能生成剧本。

zh.settings.sec.material.label: 素材
zh.settings.sec.render.desc: 成片的画面参数。改动会作用到下一轮生成。
zh.settings.sec.render.label: 画面

zh.settings.sec.subtitle.label: 字幕与节奏

zh.settings.status.noBridge: 未连接到桌面应用，配置只能读取但无法保存
zh.settings.status.noBridgeSave: 未连接到桌面应用，无法保存
zh.settings.subtitle.render.desc: ass = 合并期直接烧（快）；remotion = 叠透明层（慢，需 remotion 依赖）

zh.tts.hint2: 按角色选择音色；确认后开始配音、找素材并合成成片。
zh.tts.hintSetup: 配音还没开始：确认音色与语速后，点「开始生成配音」。已合成的句子会落盘，中断后只补缺失的部分。
zh.tts.regenerateConfirmBody: 已生成的配音，以及已匹配的素材与成片都会作废。

en.about.app.name: AI Short Video Generator
en.about.app.tagline: Link → script → voice → footage → final cut
en.about.app.title: About
en.app.busy: A task is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
en.app.name: AI Short Video Studio
en.app.noContent: Nothing to work with yet. Go back and paste a link or some text.
en.app.noLlmKey: No LLM API key yet. Add it in Settings → Preferences (Ctrl+,) and it applies immediately.
en.app.resume: Resumed the last task ({time} · {status}), stopped at “{step}”
en.app.tagline: Link → script → voice → footage → final cut, all automatic
en.common.desktopOnly: This feature is only available in the desktop app.
en.common.settingsDesktopOnly: Preferences are only available in the desktop app. In the browser, edit the config file directly.
en.env.ffmpegMissing: Not found — video compositing will fail
en.env.needLlm: No API key — cannot generate scripts
en.env.needMaterial: Configure at least one of Pixabay / Pexels keys, or footage matching fails
en.env.needTts: Configure at least one of Edge voices / CosyVoice / Doubao Seed-TTS
en.env.title: Environment
en.error.render: Failed to render the final cut
en.input.afterScript: The script is written but not confirmed. Editing the content and hitting Regenerate rewrites it entirely; to change only the style or cast, go to Script.
en.input.hint: Paste a web link or the article text. Next you pick a script style and cast, then start generation manually.
en.input.label: Content (URL or text)
en.input.needContent: Add a link or some text first
en.input.placeholder: e.g. https://example.com/article — or paste the article text
en.input.regenerateHint: Discard the current script and everything after it, then redo the whole flow with the content above
en.input.subHint: Paste an article link (the text is fetched automatically) or the text itself. The more specific, the closer the script.
en.material.cardApplied: Section {n} now uses an info card. It takes effect when you confirm.
en.material.cardAutoHint: Decide per section which ones suit a person / compare / timeline / stat card, then generate and layer those automatically
en.material.cardCleared: Section {n} is back to live footage
en.material.cardHint: Turn this section's lines into a person / compare / timeline / stat card layered over the clip
en.material.cardRewritten: Card copy changed — the final cut will be recomposited with the new card
en.material.changeCardHint: Have AI rewrite this card with a new headline
en.material.changeClipTitle: Replace the clip underneath; the info card stays
en.material.chapterHint: Chapter card duration, 0 = no chapter cards
en.material.failedDetail: Last match didn't work out. Try a different footage source or resolution, then hit Re-match with new source.
en.material.hintDone: Every section has a clip. Open them, swap any you dislike, then continue to the final cut to set subtitles and music.
en.material.needTts: Voiceover isn't finished yet. Footage matching starts once it completes.
en.material.newClip: Section {n} has a new clip. It applies after you hit Next: final cut.
en.material.noNewClip: No new candidate clips found for section {n}.
en.material.overlayOnly: Overlays the footage without replacing it
en.material.previewRetry: Preview isn't ready — click to retry
en.material.ready: Voiceover is done. Hit Start matching and AI finds usable clips for each section.
en.material.regenerateConfirmBody: Matched footage and the generated final cut will be discarded.
en.material.regenerateHint: After changing the setup above, Regenerate redoes the footage with the new settings; matched footage and the final cut are invalidated.
en.material.rejudgeCard: Have AI re-decide which card fits this section
en.material.runHint: Hit Start matching to run this setup in one pass: intro → per-section clips → info cards.
en.material.searching: Searching and downloading clips per line. They'll be listed section by section here.
en.material.stopped: Stopped. The clips matched so far are incomplete — Continue fills in the rest.
en.material.title: Footage
en.prompts.title: Prompts
en.render.bgmPlaceholder: Leave blank for the built-in track, or enter a filename from the music folder
en.render.empty: The final cut appears here once generated.
en.render.hint: The final cut is saved locally. Change the parameters above and regenerate — voiceover and footage don't need to rerun.
en.render.hintNoTts: Footage is ready. Set subtitles and background music, then hit Generate final cut.
en.render.noSpeakers: The script has no characters yet.
en.render.noTask: No task yet. Go back to step one and generate a script.
en.result.bgmToggle: Add background music (unchecked keeps voiceover only)
en.result.fontHint: Font size is computed from the frame width ({n}px at {w}×{h}) and can be edited. Changing it re-renders the segments; changing only the music reuses them and just remixes.
en.result.hint: The final cut is ready, using the clips below. To change footage, hit Regenerate above with a new source.
en.result.noTask: No task yet. Generate a script and confirm footage first.
en.result.title: Final cut
en.script.blankDefault: Leave blank to use the default names
en.script.confirmedReadonly: This script was confirmed and used for voiceover. This is the version from that moment (read-only).
en.script.confirming: Your script is ready for review
en.script.done: Running — switches to the script page when done
en.script.hint: Set the style and cast names, then hit Start. AI reads the content and writes the script, then waits here for your review.
en.script.hint2: Edit lines directly, delete any you don't need, then continue to voice selection. Recording starts only after you confirm.
en.script.nextHint: Next: pick a script style and cast, then writing starts after you confirm
en.script.regenerateConfirmBody: The current script (including unsaved edits), plus the generated voiceover, footage and final cut will all be discarded.
en.script.regenerateHint: Discard the current script (including unsaved edits) and everything after it, then redo the whole flow with the content, style and cast above
en.script.regenerateHint2: After changing style or cast above, Regenerate rewrites the whole script; the current script and everything after it are invalidated.
en.script.running: AI is fetching the content and writing the script. It will stop here for review when done.
en.script.stopped: Stopped. Fetching and writing save progress step by step — Continue picks up from the last finished step.
en.script.title: Script style & cast
en.settings.app.title: Preferences
en.settings.cards.accent.desc: #rrggbb — layout cards use only this color
en.settings.cards.chapter.desc: From paragraph 2 on, up to 6 cards
en.settings.cards.introEnabled.desc: Falls back to a subtitle title on failure
en.settings.err.invalid: Some fields are invalid — jumped to the first one
en.settings.err.numberOnly: Numbers only — no units or letters
en.settings.general.language.title: Language
en.settings.general.theme.title: Appearance
en.settings.llm.thinking.desc: Off is faster and steadier; scripting needs no reasoning
en.settings.material.quoteFallback: Use design cards when footage is missing
en.settings.material.shots.desc: 1 = one clip for the whole paragraph
en.settings.material.visionSelect.desc: Needs a model with image input; falls back to tag-based picking
en.settings.sec.audio.desc: BGM and sound effects. Turn BGM off to keep voice only.
en.settings.sec.audio.label: Background music
en.settings.sec.cards.desc: Layouts for intros, chapters, outros and info cards.
en.settings.sec.cards.label: Layout cards
en.settings.sec.general.desc: Interface preferences stored on this computer only — never written to the config file.
en.settings.sec.general.label: General
en.settings.sec.llm.desc: The chat model that writes your scripts. Add an API key to start generating.
en.settings.sec.llm.label: LLM
en.settings.sec.material.desc: Searches for clips using keywords from each line. Set up at least one source or matching will fail.
en.settings.sec.material.label: Footage
en.settings.sec.render.desc: Visual settings for the final cut. Changes apply to the next render.
en.settings.sec.render.label: Picture
en.settings.sec.speaker.desc: These two names go into the script prompt. You can override them per task on the script page.
en.settings.sec.speaker.label: Speakers
en.settings.sec.subtitle.label: Subtitles & pacing
en.settings.sec.tts.desc: Edge voices are free and need no key, so they're the default. The two engines below only show up in voice settings once a key is set.
en.settings.sec.tts.label: Voice
en.settings.status.noBridge: Not connected to the desktop app — settings can be read but not saved
en.settings.status.noBridgeSave: Not connected to the desktop app, can't save
en.settings.subtitle.render.desc: ass = burn in during merge (fast); remotion = overlay a transparent layer (slow, needs the remotion deps)
en.settings.subtitle.seed.desc: Leave blank to derive from the title. Each topic gets its own look, and reruns of the same one stay identical
en.settings.subtitle.titleDuration.desc: Without layout cards this is the subtitle title card; with them it doubles as the intro. 0 = hidden
en.settings.test.noBridge: Not connected to the desktop app
en.settings.test.title: Connection test
en.settings.tts.group.seed.note: Without a key the Doubao engine stays hidden. Voices are built in — pick one per speaker in voice settings.
en.settings.tts.workspaceId.desc: Leave blank for the default workspace
en.tts.hint: Synthesizes voiceover sentence by sentence. Intermediates are saved to disk, so cache hits are reused.
en.tts.hint2: Pick a voice per character. After you confirm, voiceover, footage matching and compositing run in order.
en.tts.hintSetup: Voiceover hasn't started. Confirm voice and speed, then hit Start. Finished sentences stay on disk, so an interruption only fills in the gaps.
en.tts.regenerateConfirmBody: The generated voiceover, matched footage and the final cut will all be discarded.
en.tts.regenerateHint: After changing voice or speed, Regenerate redos the voiceover; matched footage and the final cut are invalidated too.
en.tts.running: Rendering segments → joining → mixing. Switches to the final cut when done.
en.tts.stopped: Stopped. Finished steps are already on disk — Continue picks up where it left off.
en.tts.stoppedScript: Stopped, but the script is written. Continue runs the rest without redoing finished steps.
en.tts.title: Voice generation
